NO VERDICT RECORDED BY THE ASSIGNEE -- the reading, for the CVO to grade.

(1) ROUTER-SIDE, BY DECLARATION, and a population-side fix has nowhere to land. The populations comp-which ranks over -- graph-call-manifest.yaml tools_index and comp-coverage-map.yaml -- describe TOOLS, not SUBJECTS; neither carries a gold-script id. THE AUTHORITY, found by census not invented: comp-find 'GOLD_ID' .tools --all -> 2 hits across 397 files, BOTH in .tools/comp-which (:1279 DEF, :2236 use), so the pattern has no second consumer and no competing id-space. This estate registers gold ids IN THE FILESYSTEM and says so in its own resolvers: pipeline_cli.py:203 _discover_script_trees@0e9ef40b37 ('re-derive the script-tree universe from the FILESYSTEM at call time -- NOT a frozen list ... A longer hand-list would have gone stale ... a predicate cannot') and :3016 _resolve_gold_script (globs the gold dirs). The check is therefore a PREDICATE over the same substrate the estate's own resolver uses -- 30 data/*/scripts/<layer>/ dirs walked, 3 carrying 74 distinct ids -- and NO registry was edited.

(2) P-6, INHERITANCE. Inside comp-which: EVERY ranker path inherits it, and by POSITION rather than by patching each one. The gate sits in main() immediately after `gid = GOLD_ID.search(q)` and BEFORE `hits` is built, so on an unresolved subject none of these is reached: the RULES curated loop, _default_router (the DR2 posterior, the DEFAULT router), the LEGACY cascade, _surface_first's ledger drill, _posterior_backstop, the manifest backstop, the grep/glob fallback (_run_primitive), and _emit_json (a dedicated kind 'subject-unresolved' is emitted instead -- verified). --route-only reaches it and SHOWS the refusal (verified). The WARM in-process path (comp-which-routing-test.py:411 calls this same main()) inherits it, which is exactly why the per-question state is RESET at the top of main() -- module state is safe in the cold CLI and is not safe there. OUTSIDE comp-which: NO, and here is the measured residual -- comp-find 'comp_route[_a-z]*\.route\(' org infra .tools --all -> 5 direct route() call sites in first-party source outside this file, across 4 files: comp_route_shadow.py:92, comp_route_eval.py:134 (via _sh.comp_route), comp_learns_leg4_exercise.py:73 and :180, and NFRA_TOOLHEALTH/clause_b_close_loop_exercise.py:111-112. ALL FIVE ARE EVALUATION / EXERCISE HARNESSES; none routes a seat anywhere. So every AGENT-FACING path inherits the check and the non-inheriting callers are measurement code -- which is the honest shape of P-6's warning: a SECOND router would not inherit it, and the reason none does today is that there is only one.

(3) WHAT A SEAT SEES, and yes a person can act on it without a follow-up. In order: 'SUBJECT NOT FOUND: "INF_D_20"'; that it was NOT ROUTED and why (0 ranked, 'deliberately, not for want of a match'); 'AUTHORITY CHECKED: data/*/scripts/*/*.py stems matching GOLD_ID -- 74 ids across 3 directories: data/black_diamond/scripts/gold, data/cot/scripts/gold, data/inf/scripts/gold'; then the nearest real ids WITH the directory each lives in, under 'These are CANDIDATES, NOT a route: comp-which did NOT decide you meant one of them'; then two concrete next commands. rc 1 is comp-which's OWN abstain code (:2170), so a PROGRAM sees it too, and the spilled rank file carries subject_resolved: 'false' so a measurement can tell '0 rows because nothing fit' from '0 rows because the subject does not exist'. Measured before: rank 1 = 'comp-pipescript io INF_D_99', score 2.00, vetted: true, rc 0, 78 rows.

(4) WHAT IT DOES NOT COVER. (i) A subject that exists in a script tree but not in the SERVED graph -- the check answers 'is there a file with this stem', not 'does the estate's graph carry this node'; a script committed but never deployed resolves true here and can still dead-end downstream. This is the CVO's own example and it is NOT covered. (ii) Non-gold-id subjects: an S3 key, a lambda name, a portal component, a column name -- the same defect class on other id spaces, untouched. (iii) A second router (see 2). (iv) The id-space is a STEM census, not a semantic one: a file whose stem matches GOLD_ID but is not a real pipeline script resolves true. (v) Ranking: nothing about scoring or ordering changed for a resolved subject -- measured byte-equal on 5 of 5 questions.
